description_en: Debugs a started execution that contains an event trigger task or alert trigger task. If the operation is called, a message body is sent to the event trigger task or alert trigger task. After the trigger task receives the message body, the trigger task generates a new child execution
description_zh: 事件触发器或告警触发器任务，可对该类执行发送消息体内容，消息体会使事件或告警任务产生一个新的子执行

name: TriggerExecution

parameters.help_en: The ID of the event-, alert-, or timer-triggered execution
parameters.name: execution_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:

*   Event
*   Alarm
*   Timer
parameters.help_zh:
触发器类型：
- Event
- Alarm
- Timer
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The message body to be sent to the trigger task
parameters.help_zh: 发送给触发器任务的消息体
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
